customManagers.description: matrix.json's base image is a JSON string, not a Dockerfile ARG -- docker-bake.hcl always overrides the Dockerfile's own ARG BASE_IMAGE from it, so this is the only place a digest pin has any effect

packageRules.description: Auto-merge base image digest/patch refreshes once CI is green
Minor/major base bumps stay as PRs for review
Auto-merge the matrix.json base-image digest pin the same way as the Dockerfile bases
A new action release (minor/major) stays a PR for review

A mutable action tag can be force-moved to a malicious commit (the 2026-03 trivy-action hijack); require the pin to sit for a week and never auto-merge it, so a hijack has a review window instead of landing on main unattended
Auto-merge action version-tag refreshes (the SHA still gets pinned by hand from the new tag) once CI is green

Never let Renovate pin or bump our own published images -- the corpus job publishes ghcr.io/lotuswebagency/php(/corpus) and the release job publishes lotuswebagency/php, so a PR against either is a self-referential loop: it changes php/pgo/Dockerfile.corpus's ARG BUILDER_IMAGE default (never actually read -- build-corpus.sh always passes --build-arg BUILDER_IMAGE) or matrix.json's own image, invalidates INPUTS_HASH, and triggers a full rebuild that produces a new digest for Renovate to bump again
